title: populus deltoides var. virginiana
intro: Populus deltoides var. virginiana, commonly known as Eastern Cottonwood, is a deciduous tree native to Eastern North America. The bark of this plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving respiratory issues, and acting as a natural diuretic. The therapeutic actions of the bark include its anti-inflammatory, anti-bacterial, and anti-fungal properties. The bioactive constituents of the bark include salicin, a compound similar to aspirin, as well as other flavonoids and phenolic acids.
